records.statement: Yamaha's 2027 YZ125X owner's service manual lists standard jetting main #160, pilot #65, needle NYCF clip 2 (Keihin PWK38S), with mains #162/#160/#158 for cold/mild/hot general conditions.

standard settings.pilot air screw: 1-1/2 turns out (factory-set individually; record your bike's turns)

effect ranges.pilot air screw: fully closed to 1/8 throttle (turn in = richer, out = leaner)

values.jet needle notes: Needles share taper angle; letters change straight-portion diameter and taper start. Changing taper start = 0.5 clip groove (e.g. 0.5 groove leaner than NYCF-2nd groove -> NYDF-2nd groove). Too rich mid-range: raise clip one groove (needle down); too lean: lower clip one groove.
values.pilot air screw chart note: Chart pilot-air-screw values are added to the ex-factory number of back-out turns (e.g. ex-factory 1 -> add 1 to the chart value).

spark plug heat range.rule: Start with the standard heat range and adjust carburetor settings from plug discoloration; if the main jet must change by ±30 calibration numbers, change plug heat range and reselect the main jet; never change heat range more than ±1 rank; non-standard plugs must be resistance type
spark plug heat range.plug reading: Normal = dry, burnt brown insulator; too lean (over burned) = whitish insulator; too rich (oil fouled) = sooty, wet insulator

symptom guide (summary).1/4–3/4 throttle lean / hard breathing: lower jet needle clip one groove
symptom guide (summary).1/4–1/2 throttle slow pick-up, white smo: raise jet needle clip one groove
symptom guide (summary).poor response at extremely low speed: reduce pilot jet / turn out pilot air screw

records.statement: Yamaha's 2027 YZ125X owner's service manual lists a 4.2 N/mm standard fork spring and 48 N/mm standard shock spring with optional springs, 90–100 mm rider sag, and a 3.846 (50/13) standard sprocket ratio with 47–52T rear options.

values.front fork oil amount (tuning chapter): standard 280 cm³ (9.5 US oz, 9.9 Imp.oz); adjustment range 260–365 cm³ (8.8–12.3 US oz, 9.2–12.9 Imp.oz); oil Yamaha Suspension Oil S1; change in 5 cm³ (0.2 US oz, 0.2 Imp.oz) steps (oil amount tunes air-spring/bottoming near end of stroke)
values.fork spring change guidance: Softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks, compression in 1–2 clicks. Stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks, compression out 1–2 clicks.
values.unequal-pitch note: Unequal-pitch spring is softer initially than equal-pitch and resists bottoming under full compression.
values.standard shock overall length: 490 mm (19.29 in); never fit a shock longer than standard
values.rider sag (sunken length a - b): 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in), rider astride; measured from rear axle center to the mark on rear fender; re-check after break-in; change to an optional spring if not achievable
values.shock spring change guidance: Softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks; stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks; rebound changes also shift compression—correct by reducing compression.

suspension symptom guide (summary).front stiff over entire range: compression ~2 clicks softer; oil −5–10 cm³; softer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).front soft over entire range / bottoming: compression ~2 clicks firmer; oil +5–10 cm³; stiffer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).low front posture: rebound ~2 clicks softer; set rear sag 95–100 mm (3.7–3.9 in); oil +5 cm³
suspension symptom guide (summary).high ('obtrusive') front posture: compression ~2 clicks softer; set rear sag 90–95 mm (3.5–3.7 in); softer spring; oil −5–10 cm³
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear adjustment steps: rebound 2-click steps, low-speed compression 1-click steps, high-speed compression 1/6-turn steps
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear bottoming: high compression firmer ~1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; stiffer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear spongy and unstable: rebound ~2 clicks firmer; low compression 1 click firmer; stiffer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear stiff travel: high compression ~1/6 turn softer; sag 90–100 mm; softer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear poor grip: rebound softer ~2 clicks, low compression firmer 1 click, high compression firmer 1/6 turn, sag 90–100 mm, softer spring

sprockets.gearing guidance: Lower (numerically smaller) ratio for long straights, higher for tight courses; set so the engine reaches maximum revs near the end of the longest straight without over-revving; tune to the section that most affects the race result.

records.notes: The manual does not tabulate springs by rider weight; it lists spring options by rate with part numbers plus symptom-based setting guidance.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2024 YZ125 owner's service manual lists standard jetting main #160, pilot #75, needle NYDF clip 2 (Keihin PWK38S), with mains #162/#160/#158 for cold/mild/hot general conditions.

standard settings.pilot air screw: 2-5/8 turns out (factory-set individually; record your bike's turns)

effect ranges.pilot air screw: fully closed to 1/8 throttle (turn in = richer, out = leaner)
effect ranges.power jet: below 8500 r/min, 1/2 to full throttle (larger = richer)

values.jet needle notes: Needles share taper angle; letters change straight-portion diameter and taper start. Changing taper start = 0.5 clip groove (e.g. 0.5 groove leaner than NYDF-3rd groove -> NYEF-3rd groove). Too rich mid-range: raise clip one groove (needle down); too lean: lower clip one groove.
values.pilot air screw chart note: Chart pilot-air-screw values are added to the ex-factory number of back-out turns (e.g. ex-factory 1 -> add 1 to the chart value).

spark plug heat range.rule: Start with the standard heat range and adjust carburetor settings from plug discoloration; if the main jet must change by ±30 calibration numbers, change plug heat range and reselect the main jet; never change heat range more than ±1 rank; non-standard plugs must be resistance type
spark plug heat range.plug reading: Normal = dry, burnt brown insulator; too lean (over burned) = whitish insulator; too rich (oil fouled) = sooty, wet insulator

symptom guide (summary).1/4–3/4 throttle lean / hard breathing: lower jet needle clip one groove
symptom guide (summary).1/4–1/2 throttle slow pick-up, white smo: raise jet needle clip one groove
symptom guide (summary).poor response at extremely low speed: reduce pilot jet / turn out pilot air screw

records.statement: Yamaha's 2024 YZ125 owner's service manual lists a 4.2 N/mm standard fork spring and 48 N/mm standard shock spring with optional springs, 90–100 mm rider sag, and a 3.769 (49/13) standard sprocket ratio with 47–52T rear options.

values.front fork oil amount (tuning chapter): standard 305 cm³ (10.3 US oz, 10.8 Imp.oz); adjustment range 285–365 cm³ (9.6–12.3 US oz, 10.1–12.9 Imp.oz); oil Yamaha Suspension Oil S1; change in 5 cm³ (0.2 US oz, 0.2 Imp.oz) steps (oil amount tunes air-spring/bottoming near end of stroke)
values.fork spring change guidance: Softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks, compression in 1–2 clicks. Stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks, compression out 1–2 clicks.
values.unequal-pitch note: Unequal-pitch spring is softer initially than equal-pitch and resists bottoming under full compression.
values.standard shock overall length: 490 mm (19.29 in); never fit a shock longer than standard
values.rider sag (sunken length a - b): 90–100 mm (3.5–3.9 in), rider astride; measured from rear axle center to the mark on rear fender; re-check after break-in; change to an optional spring if not achievable
values.shock spring change guidance: Softer spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks; stiffer spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks; rebound changes also shift compression—correct by reducing compression.

suspension symptom guide (summary).front stiff over entire range: compression ~2 clicks softer; oil −5–10 cm³; softer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).front soft over entire range / bottoming: compression ~2 clicks firmer; oil +5–10 cm³; stiffer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).low front posture: rebound ~2 clicks softer; set rear sag 95–100 mm (3.7–3.9 in); oil +5 cm³
suspension symptom guide (summary).high ('obtrusive') front posture: compression ~2 clicks softer; set rear sag 90–95 mm (3.5–3.7 in); softer spring; oil −5–10 cm³
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear adjustment steps: rebound 2-click steps, low-speed compression 1-click steps, high-speed compression 1/6-turn steps
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear bottoming: high compression firmer ~1/6 turn; sag 90–100 mm; stiffer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear spongy and unstable: rebound ~2 clicks firmer; low compression 1 click firmer; stiffer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear stiff travel: high compression ~1/6 turn softer; sag 90–100 mm; softer spring
suspension symptom guide (summary).rear poor grip: rebound softer ~2 clicks, low compression firmer 1 click, high compression firmer 1/6 turn, sag 90–100 mm, softer spring
